div.head: Ps Cn for 28
div.ab: Bosco nec subbosco nostro sine licentia primariorum foreste nemo manum apponat; quodsi quis fecerit, reus sit fractionis regalis chacee.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 625 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: Let no one lay a hand on our wood or underwood without the leave of the chief men of the forest; and if anyone does so, let him be guilty of breach of the royal chase.

note.seg: Unterholz, jedoch mit Ausnahme des kleinen crimen uiridis 21, 2. Doch meint Verf. nur Wald innerhalb der foresta, nicht etwa auf sonstiger Königsdomäne
Underwood, but with the exception of the minor crimen uiridis, 21, 2. But the author means only woodland within the foresta, not on other royal demesne
per uisum custodum forestæ Dial. scacc. I 11; forestariorum et uiridariorum Assisa a. 1198, also leichter, wie Anm. r
